title: The Grass Track
sentences: Jill went to the track to run with the run club.
The club had one lap to run.
Mud was on the track, so the club had to stop.
Jill had a look at the grass.
She said, “The grass can be our track.”
Jill went into the grass and ran.
The club had a look at Jill.
Jill ran one lap in the grass.
The club ran one lap in the grass.
For lap two, the grass was the track.

comprehensionQuestion.question: Where did Jill run after she left the track?
